title: Learning Existing Social Conventions via Observationally Augmented Self-Play
reasoning: The paper focuses on multi-agent reinforcement learning and game theory to help agents learn social conventions (coordination equilibria). While it was presented at an AI ethics conference and discusses social norms, it is a technical algorithmic paper that evaluates coordination in game-theoretic simulations (traffic, Stag Hunt) rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
